players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce welcomes Avolon order for 70 Trent 7000 engines (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Rolls-Royce won an order for 70 Trent 7000 engines from Avolon to power 35 Airbus A330neo aircraft (A330-900s); the Trent 7000 is the exclusive engine for the A330neo and has more than five million flying hours; Rolls-Royce says the A330neo / Trent 7000 combination delivers a 14% better fuel burn per seat than the previous generation.
